summary: Bandwidth Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $275 million private offering of 0% convertible senior notes due 2032 to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A. The notes are senior unsecured, bear no interest, and mature July 1, 2032; net proceeds are not specified. The offering is expected to settle on June 18, 2026, and includes a 13-day over-allotment option for up to $41.25 million additional principal. No premium, stake, or board recommendation is mentioned. This is a standard convertible debt financing, not a special situation; thus category is None.
